task_title: Azure dev-build ingest and issue proxy

plan_review.notes: Reviewed the implemented plan; addressed request caps, exact configurable CORS, PNG validation, scoped PAT documentation, retry-safe issue claim markers, lifecycle cleanup, AzureWebJobsStorage, and function workspace verification. APIM/queue alternatives were considered but rejected as unnecessary for this single-hop low-volume endpoint.

independent_grade.notes: The diff is tightly scoped to the dev-build ingest Function plus required infra/env wiring, and the completed 3-apple review ledger is present and internally consistent (plan review, two code-review rounds, independent grade). Request validation, CORS allowlisting, blob persistence, idempotent issue-link reuse, and pending-marker issue filing controls are coherent with no high-confidence blocker in the changed code. Coverage is adequate but limited to validation/error-path behavior (including malformed screenshots) rather than full storage/issue happy paths, so test_coverage is good enough to pass but not maximal.
